messages:
ashley: Following up from the authz postmortem — consolidating action items so we can track ownership/timelines. Please ack and add ETA if different. Postmortem: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/PM-2345

ashley: Action items I'm tracking (short):
- Kevin: fix JWT expiry + validation edge case (race on refresh)
- Lina: permissions mapping audit + default-deny rollout
- Mike: audit-logging retention + backfill missing events
- Sam: bulk secrets rotation for pre-2025 tokens + rotation automation

kevin: Ack. I'll take JWT validation. Root cause was missing expiry check in the cached token path + a race when refresh and validate run concurrently. Plan: add atomic validate-or-refresh, unit + integration tests, and a canary job. ETA: Wed EOD (48h). Snippet for the fix I'll add to the PR:
```python
# validate-or-refresh pseudo
with token_lock(token_id):
    if token.expired():
        token = refresh(token)
    validate(token)
```

lina: I can own permissions audit. I'll run a mapping diff vs prod (service -> allowed actions) and mark any overly-broad roles. Default-deny rollout needs product ok for a handful of endpoints (billing, admin). ETA: Fri EOD. Will open RFC for exceptions.

mike: I'll own audit logging. Action items: ensure every auth decision emits an event, add immutable request_id, and backfill the ~12k missing events we saw between 03/11-03/12. Need temporary S3 write access to backfill bucket and ~4h maintenance window for the backfill job. @ashley can you approve S3 access? ETA for backfill scheduling: next Mon night.

sam: I'll run the secrets rotation. Proposal: rotate all service tokens created before 2025-01-01 and add expiration metadata to new tokens. I have a rotation script that can do phased rotation per service. Need a low-traffic maintenance window and will coordinate with ops. ETA: Tue next week for first batch. Example command: `./rotate_tokens --since 2025-01-01 --batch 50`

sec-bot: New follow-up tasks added to tracker: INC-4891, INC-4892, INC-4893, INC-4894. Owners set from thread. Reminders scheduled: weekly @channel for 4 weeks. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4891

ashley: Two process notes from postmortem: 1) recurring pattern: token refresh race seen in two incidents (Feb + Mar) — we should instrument metrics, alert on spike of token_validation_failures; 2) lack of audit events during the window made root cause analysis slow — mandatory audit for auth decisions is a hard requirement now.

kevin: I'll add metrics & alerts: `jwt_validation_failures`, `token_refresh_race_count`, and a synthetic canary that exercises refresh path every 5m. Also adding a regression test to the CI that simulates concurrent refresh+validate.

lina: PR opened for permission defaults (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/782). It sets default deny for newly onboarded services and a migration plan for existing roles. Asking product for sign-off by Thu.

mike: @ashley S3 access request approved, path: s3://redwood-infra/audit-backfill/INC-4893. Backfill job scheduled Fri 23:00-01:00 UTC. Will stream logs to #eng-runtime during run.

sam: Rotation plan: phased by service criticality, will post runbook in ops playbooks. Small snippet for dry-run: `./rotate_tokens --since 2025-01-01 --batch 5 --dry-run`. I'll also add audit events for rotation actions.

ashley: Summary of owners + deadlines (locking these unless you reply): Kevin - Wed EOD; Lina - Fri EOD; Mike - Fri night backfill; Sam - Tue next week first rotation batch. If anything slips, please update the tracker INC-4891..4894 and ping me. Weekly sync scheduled Friday 15:00 UTC for status. Thanks all :thumbsup:
